tokens.npc_dota_hero_ursa_bio: Ulfsaar the Warrior is the fiercest member of an ursine tribe, protective of his land and his people. During the long winters, while the mothers sleep and nurse their cubs, the males patrol the lands above as tireless, vigilant defenders of their ancient ways. Hearing dim but growing rumors of a spreading evil, Ulfsaar headed out beyond the boundaries of his wild wooded homeland, intending to track down and destroy the threat at its source, before it could endanger his people. He is a proud creature with a bright strong spirit, utterly trustworthy, a staunch ally and defender.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_ursa_hype: With each swipe of his claws, Ursa increases his target's vulnerability to his next attack. Capable of briefly increasing how swiftly he can strike, and able to slow down nearby prey, he quickly tears apart his enemies.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_ursa_npedesc1: Deals more damage with every hit to the same foe

Hearing dim but growing rumors of a spreading evil, Ulfsaar headed out beyond the boundaries of his wild wooded homeland, intending to track down and destroy the threat at its source, before it could endanger his people. He is a proud creature with a bright strong spirit, utterly trustworthy, a staunch ally and defender.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Interrupts Ursa's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Caster|Leap}}
*** Grants all ability effects upon cast.
*** Applies a non-disabling {{M|upward movement}}, and leaps at {{#expr:{{#var:Earthshock value2}}/{{#var:Earthshock value6}}}}-speed, over {{#var:Earthshock value6}} seconds.
*** Leaps {{#var:Earthshock value2}}-distance forward and 83-distance {{M|upward movement|text=upward}}.
**** The leap duration varies corresponding to the terrain.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_ursa
data.bio_loc: Ulfsaar the Warrior is the fiercest member of an ursine tribe, protective of his land and his people. During the long winters, while the mothers sleep and nurse their cubs, the males patrol the lands above as tireless, vigilant defenders of their ancient ways. Hearing dim but growing rumors of a spreading evil, Ulfsaar headed out beyond the boundaries of his wild wooded homeland, intending to track down and destroy the threat at its source, before it could endanger his people. He is a proud creature with a bright strong spirit, utterly trustworthy, a staunch ally and defender.
data.hype_loc: With each swipe of his claws, Ursa increases his target's vulnerability to his next attack. Capable of briefly increasing how swiftly he can strike, and able to slow down nearby prey, he quickly tears apart his enemies.
data.npe_desc_loc: Deals more damage with every hit to the same foe
